entry.title: Access status rechecked 13 Oct 2026, 05:18 UTC: unchanged (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational). Price, listed limits, model aliases and the model IDs on all six routes unchanged; API 90-day uptime unchanged at 99.838% with no new status-page event. Two notices shown as on 12 Oct; the hidden notice on Vercel's second Jev provider retired at the end of its seven-day shelf life (the fact is unchanged).

New page: Decisions API vs Jev (TypeSafe AI) vs Microsoft Decision 1, with Cloudflare Clef. Graded results depend on the task: OpenAI's Decisions API ahead on RPG move accuracy (B38); Jev on Portuguese exact judge score (B39); Jev and Microsoft-Decision-1 not separated on routing macro-F1, both ahead of OpenAI (B41). A dated comparison card, full table and copyable summary; no overall ranking.

Benchmarks: B42 (etsabary/luna-decisions-benchmark) graded B with 7 flags; 39 graded rows (A 11, B 13, C 8, D 7). On 1,000 five-option logic questions, Jev answered 817 correctly and OpenAI's Decisions API 612; Jev's answers come from a 22 Sep run, and the answer key is not published.

When Jev fails: no-key and bypass cells settled for model routing and content moderation. No key: 43 fail closed, 16 fall back, 7 fail open, 3 advisory, 8 not recorded (18 before). Bypass recorded for 52 of 77 (44 before). Malformed answers: agent-router is now fail-closed (35 fail-closed, 1 not recorded).

Alternatives: hosted rows rechecked 13 Oct. Microsoft-Decision-1 is listed as Preview in Foundry (Generally available on 12 Oct; cause unknown), with requests-per-minute limits by tier and Product Terms text; OpenAI's Decisions API now has four graded comparisons (B42 added); Clef data goes to the host you pick on OpenRouter. Still 33 substitutes.

Correction: Microsoft-Decision-1 was listed as Preview in Microsoft Foundry at 13 Oct 2026, 05:20 UTC; the Azure pointer said version 1, GA (as read on 12 Oct). Jev is still not listed in Foundry or Amazon Bedrock (13 Oct 2026, 05:20 UTC).

Research report of 13 October 2026: decision-API comparison page, B42, the Foundry lifecycle change, the no-key and bypass pass for model routing and content moderation, comparator review, and the access recheck.

Access status rechecked 12 Oct 2026, 05:12 UTC: unchanged (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational). Price, listed limits, model aliases and the model IDs on all six routes unchanged; API 90-day uptime unchanged at 99.838% with no new status-page event. Two notices shown as on 11 Oct; none retired.

New page, Jev plays Doom: real-time game and robot demos. Of 3 published game and robot-simulation demos that call Jev, read at pinned commits, 2 keep their last action when a call fails (doom-jev, JevPlaysSnakeGame) and 1 stops (jev-robotics-demo); none is a product. ra2web (local substitute by default) and llm-invaders (research harness) listed, not counted.

When Jev fails recounted at 77 implementations in 12 domain tables (new domain: Real-time control (games and simulations)): on a Jev error 39 stop or hold the action, 22 fall back, 8 let it through, 5 return no decision and 3 are advisory. The action goes ahead in 17 of 77; keeping the last action counts as going ahead.

Benchmarks: B41 (kartikanand73/decision-api-benchmark) graded A; 38 graded rows (A 11, B 12, C 8, D 7). On synthetic bank-withdrawal routing, Jev and Microsoft-Decision-1 were not separated on macro-F1 and both were ahead of OpenAI's Decisions API. Against small text-generating LLMs, Jev scored ahead in 6 of 10 graded studies, mixed in 2 and not ahead in 2; 5 of the 10 are grade C.

Jev alternatives: 33 listed substitutes (13 model weights, 11 local runtimes, 4 request adapters, 2 classifier/LLM approaches, 3 hosted APIs from other providers: OpenAI, Microsoft, Cloudflare). Cloudflare's Clef family added as hosted API and open weights; Microsoft-Decision-1 cells filled (data terms partly read); B41 in the evidence cells; OpenAI's data controls for the Decisions API.

Where to use Jev: Bedrock and Microsoft Foundry catalogs rechecked 12 Oct 2026, 05:15 UTC (Jev not listed); a pointer for Azure readers: Foundry lists Microsoft-Decision-1, a different model from a different provider.
Is Jev multimodal? No, text only (limitations). Is Jev free or paid? Paid; no free tier or trial found (access status). "Jev 27B VL" is a third-party model, not TypeSafe's (alternatives).

12 Oct research report: real-time control demos and their failure cells, the failure-checklist recount (77), Microsoft-Decision-1 and the Azure pointer, B41, Cloudflare's Clef family, the small-LLM count and the 72-hour decision-API look-back.

Access status rechecked 11 Oct 2026, 05:17 UTC: unchanged (signups open, no new-user credit, API operational). Price, listed limits, model aliases and the model IDs on all six routes unchanged; API 90-day uptime 99.835% to 99.838% with no new incident listed; the status page now also lists api.us.typesafe.ai under "API status by geography". Two notices shown as on 10 Oct; none retired.

Benchmarks: three comparisons first listed as leads graded A from metric and results files opened at pinned commits (B38–B40); 37 graded rows (A 10, B 12, C 8, D 7). Two independent grade-A comparisons of Jev with OpenAI's Decisions API differ by task: Decisions API ahead on RPG move choices (B38); Jev ahead on exact judge score in Portuguese, level on routing and injection (B39).

Jev alternatives: the Decisions API evidence cell rebuilt from graded rows only (B38, B39; results differ by task); Microsoft-Decision-1 added as a second hosted API from another provider. Jev weights: not found on TypeSafe's site, docs, GitHub or Hugging Face (10 Oct). Of 31 listed substitutes: 12 model weights, 11 local runtimes, 4 request adapters, 2 classifier/LLM approaches, 2 hosted APIs from other providers (OpenAI, Microsoft).

Coding agents settled: Of 24 integrations read in source, 13 act on Jev's answer, 10 do not, 1 is unsettled. On a Jev error the 13: 5 let the call run, 3 hold, 5 fall back. jev-triage, the jev-for-all launcher and hermes-jev-mana (inert after the documented install) counted; Hoppin-Sorter/jev-router not settled.

When Jev fails recounted at 74 implementations: on a Jev error 38 stop or hold the action, 20 fall back, 8 let it through, 5 return no decision and 3 are advisory. The action goes ahead in 15 of 74. LanceDB's no-key cell is now fail-closed (read 11 Oct).
